'''Brandon Chang''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Vegas DPC]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Real HB]], according to Caleb Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2235">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-vegas-dpc-4-28-01d2235/ vegas-dpc-4-28-01], DeckTech (CALEB "_WRAITH_" SMITH, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-vegas-dpc-4-28-01d2235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
